# redo_ensembles_claude.txt
# Blackboard / master manifest of the REDO production ensembles (corrected-gsq, bug-fixed) on AFFINE.
# CANONICAL location: /project/qed3/qed3/src/production/ (git-synced). RUN DATA in /lustre2/affine/redo/.
# Generated by the _fermilab block driver (Hasenbusch, Nf-packed, split-pole D/Df, frozen Zolotarev window).
# See params_L1L2_claude.md / params_massive_claude.md and cost doc redo_cost_estimate_claude.md.
# 26 streams = 18 massless (Nf{2,4,6}) + 8 massive (Nf2).
#

# # status column:  DONE = target reached = CLOSED (its wrapper slot is commented out in run_wrapper_redo_claude.sh;
# #                 re-apply no longer submits it).   running = still filling; slots p5-p8 are the ONLY active ones.
# # CLOSED slots (commented out): p0-p4 (L1 all + L2 Nf2 gsq1.0) , p9-p12 (all massive).  ACTIVE: p5,p6,p7,p8 (L2 tail).
# NOTE (2026-07-16): the L1/L2 rows below are the AFFINE (Fermilab, SLURM) campaign. The L=4 ensembles are
# generated SEPARATELY on the BU SCC (SGE qsub) with the _scc driver -- see the "L4 (SCC)" section appended
# at the BOTTOM of this file (impl plan: scc_L4_production_impl_plan_claude.md). L4 is Nf=2-only (per NM).
#
# Columns (whitespace-separated; col 1 = ensemble dir basename, contains ckpoint_lat.<k>):
#   ensemble   output dir3 basename
#   type       massless (mRe=0) | massive (mRe!=0)
#   slot       wrapper pair-slot p<idx> (run_wrapper_redo_claude.sh); packed 2/GPU under MPS
#   L Nf gsq mRe   lattice refinement / flavors / coupling / physical mass (R=1)
#   target     compiled trajectory cap -DKMAX (massless L1=2000 L2=1200 ; massive L1=120 L2=80)
#   ncfg       ckpoint_lat configs on disk NOW (snapshot)
#   status     DONE (>=target-1) | running
#   acc%       acceptance over all this stream's logs ; maxdH = max |dH|  (health)
#
# Columns (whitespace-separated; col 1 = ensemble dir basename under /lustre2/affine/redo/):
#   ensemble  dir3 basename   type massless|massive   slot wrapper pair p<idx>
#   L Nf gsq mRe   refinement / flavors / coupling / physical mass (R=1)
#   target -DKMAX (massless L1=2000 L2=1200 ; massive L1=120 L2=80)   ncfg NOW   status DONE(closed)|running
#   acc% acceptance over all logs   maxdH max|dH|
#
# OBS-STATE columns (ADDED 2026-07-17, local measurement campaign; plan
# redo_obs_measurement_impl_plan_claude.md; style of both_3d jj_ensembles_claude.txt existing_jj).
# Every data row (all three sections) carries TWO extra trailing columns:
#   loc_ncfg   ckpoint_lat configs pulled to LOCAL barracuda22 so far (0 = not pulled yet)
#   obs        LOCAL obs-calc state: comma-joined tag:N (N = configs measured), "-" = none. Tags:
#              thm  = gluonic thermalization series (stride 1; sets the per-ensemble kmin cut)
#              conn = connected jj+scalar Y_lm tower (GPU, stride 20)  [massless]
#              disc = disconnected jj (GPU, stride 20)                 [massless]
#              glue = F shapes corr ; f2 = F^2 shapes corr (CPU, stride 1)  [massless]
#              cond = scalar condensate e/o+spin (GPU, stride 20)      [massive]
#
# SNAPSHOT: point-in-time (running ncfg advances). Regenerate: re-run this header's generator block.

# /projectnb/qfe/nmatsum/qed3/src/production/ via SGE (qsub), NOT SLURM/affine. Driver = the _scc block
# copy hmc_hasenbusch_block_scc_claude.cu (absolute geometry). Params: tau(s_tot)=1.0, steps{4,4,4}, gauge
# MG100, frozen Zolotarev (0.008,5), n_action=31 / n_force=11, -DMIXED_FORCE. Launcher =
# run_wrapper_L4_scc_claude.sh: **Nf=2 ONLY** (per NM 2026-07-16; Nf4/6 dropped), per-set MPS pairing
# (massless<->massless k400, massive<->massive k60 -- never mixed), 2 streams/GPU, dependent chains
# (link0 h_rt=6h then 12h, -hold_jid). 7 streams -> 4 GPU chains, arches sm_70(V100 gpu_c7.0) / sm_80(A100
# gpu_c8.0). Targets: massless -> 400 traj, massive -> 60. Monitor: bash tmp_monitor_L4_scc_claude.sh .

# ----- RSYNC (SCC -> local): pull the L4 gauge configs for local analysis --------------------------
# SCC host : scc1.bu.edu  (or scc2.bu.edu; /projectnb is shared across SCC login + compute nodes)
# SCC base : /projectnb/qfe/nmatsum/qed3/src/production/     (each ensemble = <col-1 basename>/ under here)
# Pull ONLY ckpoint_lat.* -- the gauge configs (ckpoint_lat.<k>, k=1..ncfg, ~0.64 MB each). Do NOT pull
# ckpoint_rng.* (thinned, ~0.5 GB each, not needed for measurement), logs, or binaries.
# From the LOCAL machine (repeatable; rsync sends only new k's):
#   rsync -avz --prune-empty-dirs \
#     --include='Nf2_*L4_hb*/' --include='ckpoint_lat.*' --exclude='*' \
#     nmatsum@scc1.bu.edu:/projectnb/qfe/nmatsum/qed3/src/production/ <LOCAL_DEST>/
# (or per-ensemble: rsync -avz nmatsum@scc1.bu.edu:'<SCC base><basename>/ckpoint_lat.*' <LOCAL_DEST>/<basename>/)
